meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容做成分页演示文稿,支持分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注,能直接翻页讲解。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把想法变成一份可现场翻页讲解、带备注的演示文稿。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas into a deck you can present page by page with notes.

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范为你编写幻灯片：产出可导航的 deck，含离散幻灯片、片段揭示、分支与热点导航、演讲者模式与备注，还能把现有页面转成 deck。产出是网页 deck，不是渲染出的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要幻灯片、pitch deck，或提到 presentation、deck、把现有页面转成 deck 等请求时。若你没明确要求,它会先问一句确认再动手。

howto.what_en: Claude authors HyperFrames slideshows for you: it produces a navigable deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, presenter mode with notes, and can convert an existing page into a deck. The output is a web deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, pitch deck, or mention presentation, deck, or converting an existing page into a deck. If you didn't explicitly ask, it confirms once before authoring.
